I will apply DAP and urea from the farmers' cooperative on this small plot near my home, and I will also spread cow manure because the field is close to my compound and I can carry it there easily. I will plant improved maize seed that the extension worker gave me, but I will not buy pesticides or irrigate since the meher rains will come and those things cost too much for a maize crop. My wife and children will do most of the work on this 0.14-hectare plot, though I will hire two days of labor when it is time to weed and harvest.
